title: Developer Experience with AI Pair Programmers: An Interpretivist Scoping Review
unit_of_analysis: Developer narratives, interviews, and observational studies
epistemological_rationale: Human meaning-making, lived experience, and socio-technical context are best examined through an interpretivist lens drawing on thematic and discourse analysis.

research_questions.text: How do software developers describe their experience of trust and perceived utility when pair programming with AI tools?
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Verbatim interview excerpts or observational field notes

research_questions.text: What socio-technical barriers to adoption of AI coding assistants are identified in qualitative studies?

inclusion_criteria.criterion: Involves human participants using an AI coding assistant in a real or simulated development task
Uses a qualitative or mixed-methods design (interviews, observation, think-aloud, diary study)

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Studies reporting only quantitative benchmark scores with no qualitative component
Studies not involving human participants (pure model evaluation papers)

matrix_dimensions.name: Qualitative Study Method
